# Vendored dependencies

## SheetJS CE

- File: `xlsx.full.min.js`
- Version: `0.20.3`
- Source: `https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js`
- SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`
- License: Apache-2.0, preserved in `LICENSE.sheetjs.txt`

The application loads this local copy lazily when Excel import or export is used. Updating it requires replacing the file, license text, version, and checksum together, followed by the browser smoke test.
